text:
carmen: Who's up for a tiny Champions League pool and a 'best-cheer' chair claim? thinking Thurs night in the lounge, projector on. $3 buy-in, winner gets a six-pack + bragging sticker. @here?
ben: count me in. six-pack motivation is a 10/10. where do we sign up?
hao: i'll run the bracket sheet. can everyone DM me their pick + $3 (or venmo me) by 6pm Wed? i'll post the board.
reece: i'm more concerned about chair allocation. i call the swivel chair by the outlet. it's fast and has good pivot.
maria: will bring a foam finger and the victory playlist. reece you can't hog the outlet forever. share pls.
carmen: fair. i'm assigning chair numbers to avoid the outlet wars. 1-6. first-come first-serve on the sheet.
hao: made the sheet: https://tiny.redwood/uefa-mini-pool — add name / team pick / paid?y/n
ben: added. picked Bayern bc nostalgia, paid via Venmo @ben-beer.
reece: haha Bayern again. added, picked 'cheer for chaos' (i.e., surprise upset), cash in envelope.
maria: added Real Madrid, paid. foam finger packed.
watchbot: Poll created by carmen: "Preferred viewing setup" Options: 1) Projector + chairs 2) TV + couches 3) Meetup at local pub. React with :one:, :two:, :three:.
carmen: projector gang please react :one:
ben: :one: projector vibes.
hao: :two: couch sounds tempting but projector beats it.
reece: :one: also bringing extra extension cord.
maria: :one: foam finger approved.
watchbot: Poll closed. Results: 1) Projector + chairs - 4 votes, 2) TV + couches - 1 vote, 3) Pub - 0 votes. Outcome: Projector + chairs.
ben: logistics q: who can bring a cooler for the winners' six-pack?
reece: i have a tiny cooler, i'll bring it.
hao: reminder: please annotate the sheet if you bring snacks or props so we don't double up. also i set a reminder calendar invite for 7:15pm.
watchbot: Calendar invite posted by hao: "Champions Night — Lounge" Thu 7:15pm. RSVP via invite.
carmen: last rule: absolutely zero yelling at the devs doing deploys. unless they ask for it.
maria: promise to be loud only for goals and not for merge conflicts.
ben: goal cheer training starts Thursday at 7:05. showtime.
reece: see you all Thursday. swivel chair is defended but negotiable over halftime snacks.
hao: will tally picks after Wed 6pm cutoff and post the bracket. may the best chant win.
